div.head: Wi 10
div.ab: Gif esne deþ his rade þæs dæges, VI se wið dryhten gebete oþþe sine hyd;
Gif esne deþ his rade þæs dæges, VI se wið dryhten gebete oþþe sine hyd.
If a servant performs [work] on his own counsel on that day, let him pay 6 towards his lord or his hide.
If a servant makes a journey of his own [on horseback] on that day, he shall pay 6 shillings compensation to his lord or undergo the lash.
If a servant rides on his own business on that day, he is to pay six [shillings] to his lord, or be flogged.
Wenn der Knecht [das] thut aus seinem Entschlusse an jenem Tage, so büsse jener 6 [Schilling] gegenüber seinem Herrn oder seine Haut.
If the servant does [this] of his own decision on that day, let him pay 6 [shillings] to his lord or his hide.
